summary: OSpec 1.8.12 fixes three real Goal continuation failures: mixed-case review repair scopes now bind to their snapshots, ospec update records every generated knowledge file without erasing compact-archive history, and explicitly deferred external acceptance no longer blocks unrelated implementation while final evidence gates remain strict.
new: Added ospec execute defer-blocker for explicit, evidence-backed deferral of external acceptance to the final gate.
Added complete IndexBuilder managed-path summaries for update provenance.
improved: Lets dependency-safe implementation continue after an explicitly deferred device or manual acceptance blocker while the original task remains blocked and unchecked.
Makes archive knowledge rebuilds idempotent across legacy compact archives by retaining durable target, verification, project-document, and archive-document history.
fixed: Fixed mixed-case repair scopes failing to bind to reviewed file and directory snapshots.
Fixed generated archive-knowledge documents and feature-index.md being omitted from ospec update provenance.
Fixed repeated update replacing historical implementation files and verification commands with empty sections.
Fixed external acceptance tasks forcing a premature global stop when later implementation could safely continue after explicit authorization.
docs: Documented all three confirmed project incidents, recovery behavior, external-acceptance safety contract, and task-graph planning guidance.
